reviewedDeliveredProjection.answerText:
No. A filing representative may perform data entry, but cannot submit a job filing or attest in place of the applicant or owner. The applicant must complete the Applicant of Record’s attestation and provide the final electronic signature; the owner must complete the Owner’s Attestation confirming authorization for the applicant to submit and acknowledging review of the application. Accordingly, the applicant and owner must complete their own attestations before the applicant officially submits the job filing to the Department. [DOB NOW application user guide, p. 38](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_application_user_guide.pdf#page=38) [DOB NOW: Build FAQs — Owner and Professional Responsibilities](https://www.nyc.gov/site/buildings/industry/dob-now-build-faqs.page) [Filing through DOB NOW: Build — attestation, preview and submission](https://www.nyc.gov/site/buildings/property-or-business-owner/filing-through-dob-now-build.page)

If the Owner Type is Condo Unit Owner or Co-Op Tenant-Shareholder, the Condo/Co-Op Board representative must also log in and attest, and both the owner’s and Board representative’s attestations must be completed before the filing can proceed; the stated facts do not identify the Owner Type. [DOB NOW: Build release notes, p. 20](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_build_release_notes.pdf#page=20)

Official supporting guidance — noncontrolling and not an enacted-code conclusion.

supportingSourceUses.claim: [PDF page 38](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_application_user_guide.pdf#page=38) — Page 38 of 38 STATEMENTS & SIGNATURES Applicant o f Record ’s Attestation The applicant completes the section to provide an electronic signature before the application can be submitted. The applicant also uploads a Design Professional/Licensee Seal and Signature Form (DPL - 1) as a Required Document. The date on the form cannot be more than one year from the date of submission. Owner’s Attestation All job filings in DOB NOW require confirmation from the Owner authorizing the applicant to submit the filing and acknowledging that the information in the application has been reviewed. An Owner provides confirmation by completing the Owner’s Attestation sectio n of the Statements & Signatures tab. Occupied Dwelling Units (Questions 1 - 4) If the owner selects Yes to Question 1, occupied dwelling units during construction, a Tenant Protection Plan (TPP) is required. A TPP is required if residential units will be occupied any time before the permit is signed off by DOB. Questions 3 - 4 determine compliance requirement s with tenant protection laws based on whether residential units are occupied at the time of application. Rent Controlled or Rent Stabilized Housing (Questions 5 - 6) This information is checked with data provided by NYS Homes and Community Renewal (DHCR) if at least one rent - regulated unit is in the building. If there is at least one rent - regulated unit in the building and the owner checks No to Question 5, a document is required confirming the building contains 0 rent controlled/stabilized units and expla ining why the DHCR records are inaccurate. Otherwise, owners must check Yes to Question 5. Loft Board Notification (Question 7) Owners proposing work to convert their loft buildings into legal residences are required to notify the NYC Loft Board at (212 ) 393 - 2603 and ask for the Public Information Officer. Interior Work (Questions 8 - 10) If the proposed work requires a TPP and the owner checks Yes to Questions 8, 9, or 10, a Tenant Protection Plan Compliance special inspection will not be required. Owner Arrears (Questions 11 - 12) This section appears on New Building, Alteration - CO, and Full Demolition filings to comply with Local Law 160 of 2017. If the owner answers Yes to either question, a list of exceptions will appear as Question 13. If an exception is not selected, a permit cannot be obtaine d.

DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Roles & Responsibilities: Professionals — As a Filing Representative, what information can I enter and access in DOB NOW: Build? — Filing Representatives can enter and view all filing information (PW1, Scope of Work, PW3, Technical Reports and PW2) that are part of the filing. They can make payments on jobs that they are associated with. They cannot upload plans or submit filings/permits.
Filing through DOB NOW: Build > STEP 4: Obtain Attestation — • Applicant (PE/RA), property owners and other stakeholders must electronically sign the job filing.
Filing through DOB NOW: Build > STEP 7: Submit Job Filing — • Applicant officially submits the job filing to the Department electronically.

[PDF page 20](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_build_release_notes.pdf#page=20) — February 2026 - Condo/Co - Op Board added as a Stakeholder in PW1 When Condo Unit Owner or Co - Op Tenant - Shareholder is selected as the Owner Type on a DOB NOW job filing, the Condo/Co - Op Board will be added as a required Stakeholder. ▪ The Board’s representative must log in to DOB NOW using an NYC.ID account and attest that the Board has authorized the applicant to file the application. ▪ Both the owner and the Board representative are required complete their attestations on the Statements & Signatures tab before the filing can proceed.
